newsitem.title: UK: Stanley Leisure sees hit from Ascot wins.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Leisure sees hit from Ascot wins.

text.p: British betting shop group Stanley Leisure Plc said payouts over jockey Frankie Dettori's seven wins at Ascot on Saturday were likely to total 2.25 million stg, all of which would impact half year results.
In a statement on Monday, the group said two customers had bets with returns of over 200,000 stg, another one had returns of over 100,000 stg and a further 27 bets had returns in five figures.
Dettori rode all seven winners at the Ascot race meeting on Saturday, the first time a jockey has managed such an achievement, triggering hefty payouts by UK bookmakers.
Bookmakers William Hill paid out over 550,000 stg to one punter who placed a 60 stg bet and spokesman Graham Sharpe described it as "the worst day in bookmaking history."
Stanley Leisure said that despite taking a 2.25 million stg hit, trading in its racing division had been satisfactory to date with both turnover and margins improved over a year ago.
It said fruit machines installed in shops in June were also performing at the top end of expectations.
